description: AAAI-27's style file aaai2027.sty ('2027/10/21 AAAI 2027 Submission format'), on plain article. Not on CTAN or the engine's mirror: from AuthorKit27.zip (aaai.org/authorkit27 redirects to wp-content/uploads/2026/10/AuthorKit27.zip). letterpaper as its template sets it. Two columns, set by the style. The style stops under XeTeX by design: it calls iftex's \RequirePDFTeX (aaai2027.sty l.58-59). So the first preamble line loads iftex first and makes \RequirePDFTeX do nothing. The style then loads [T1]{fontenc} and newtxtext, which under XeTeX loads fontspec and TeX Gyre Termes X (OpenType, in the mirror's newtx), and sets \pdfpagewidth/\pdfpageheight, which XeTeX has. At \begin{document} it raises a PackageError for each of 17 packages it forbids, by design: hyperref, bbm, authblk, balance, CJK, flushend, fullpage, geometry, navigator, savetrees, setspace, stfloats, tabu, titlesec, tocbibind, ulem and wrapfig (l.433-502). With natbib loaded it sets \bibliographystyle{aaai2027} itself (l.432), so aaai2027.bst is shipped.
